Who we are

Most businesses do not need more technology. They need the systems they already have to work together, the repetitive work to take care of itself, and software that fits the way they operate. That is the work we do.

About LIPI SOFT

What we do

Four disciplines, planned as one system.

Each can stand alone. Most projects draw on more than one, which is why we keep them under the same roof.

  • 01AI AutomationAI-powered workflows, document processing and business assistants that plug into the systems you already use, with human approval where it matters.
  • 02Software DevelopmentWeb applications, business software and SaaS products, engineered from database to interface and maintained after launch.
  • 03Networking & IT InfrastructureNetwork design, secure connectivity, servers and day-to-day infrastructure support for offices and multi-site businesses.
  • 04CRM SolutionsCRM implementation, customisation, automation and migration, so leads are organised, follow-ups happen and customer history is never lost.

Includes

  • Business process automation
  • AI-powered workflows
  • Intelligent document processing
  • AI assistants and business agents
  • Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) applications
  • Internal knowledge assistants

Also available: cloud and DevOps, system integration, data engineering, consulting and ongoing technical support.

Questions

Asked before most projects begin.

All frequently asked questions

We design, build and support business technology: AI automation, custom software, CRM systems, and networking and IT infrastructure. Many projects combine more than one of these, because the problem rarely sits neatly inside a single discipline.

With a conversation about the problem. If it looks like a fit, we run a discovery phase to understand your process, systems and constraints, then give you a written scope, approach and estimate before you commit to the build.

It depends on scope, the number of systems involved and how quickly decisions can be made. We give a timeline with milestones after discovery, when it can be based on real information, and we do not quote durations before then.

Pricing follows the nature of the work. Well-defined projects can be quoted at a fixed price for an agreed scope. Open-ended or evolving work is usually better suited to time-based billing with regular reporting. We recommend a model after discovery and explain why.

Integration is a normal part of our work. If your existing software offers an API or another supported way to exchange data, we connect to it. If not, we look at alternatives such as file exchange or database-level integration and explain the trade-offs.

It can be, when designed with its limits in mind. AI models make mistakes, so we use them for the steps they suit, validate their output with rules, and keep people in the approval loop for anything consequential. We do not describe any automation as error-free.
